- How do you want to collect payments? (radio_group)
    · One off payment — Sell your programme by single payment
    · In scheduled payments — Create subscriptions or sell classes with scheduled payments.
- Total price (number): This is a total price that you want to get from enrolled clients. If you have payment plans set on the programme, it is used for reference only.
- Registration fee (number): The Registration fee will be charged when the booking is created and will be added to the price of the programme or the first scheduled payment.
- Down payment (radio_group)
    · None
    · Fixed amount
    · Percentage
- Late bookings: (radio_group)
    · Disabled — Don’t allow bookings to be created after the class has started.
    · Manual confirmation required — All bookings that are created after the class has started will need to be approved manually.
    · Automatically confirmed — When enabled, any booking made after the class has started will be automatically approved, with the price calculated according to the aliquot settings.
- Aliquot price calculation settings (radio_group)
    · Automatically calculated — Aliquot price will be calculated from the number of remaining sessions in the class.
    · Calculated automatically by the number of days — Aliquot price is based on the number of remaining days in the current period and one full upcoming period.
    · No value — Bookings that will be paid in full will have zero debt/price calculated on them. Bookings that will be paid using scheduled payments won't have any debt calculated until the start of the next period. For example if period start on 10th in month and client registers on 11th, they won't get any price calculated until 10th of next month.
    · Full programme price — The price for the bookings will be always set at the full price, regardless of the date of the booking. Soeven if a client registers on the last day of the class the calculated price will be full programme price/scheduled payment.
- Billable sessions (leave empty if all are billable) (number): Enter the number of sessions that will be paid. You can thus have any number of sessions in the class, but only the number entered by you will be paid. If you enter a value ""0"", the application will count all sessions in the class, regardless of their status (except deleted). In order for the setting to work correctly, indicate in the class which sessions are paid. The functionality is suitable for programmes in which a fixed number of sessions are sold and at the same time it is important that the client uses up the given sessions (e.g. individual language programmes).
- Payments are managed by registrant (toggle): If selected and multiple bookings are submitted at once. Subsequent bookings debt will be transfered to first booking. If payment plan is created it is also created on the first booking only (with cumulative debt for all bookings). The registrant will receive one payment reference and one confirmation email.

By marking, select from the list of classes you want to show in the menu on your website as available for online booking.
- Allow online booking (toggle): Displays/hides the programme from the booking form. Thus, whether the programme will be (dis)enabled on your website for online booking.
- Priority (number): Defines the programme’s display order for clients. By default, programmes are sorted alphabetically, but a higher priority (0–1000) moves the programme higher in the list. The default priority is 0.
- Display in catalogue (toggle): By marking, classes will be displayed in the menu on your website

    · Default - let client choose
    · Offer full programme booking only

    · Blocks only (if available)

- Allow multiple bookings for the programme (toggle): Suitable for parents with twins. Normally, booking for twins needs to be done one by one. With this setup, a parent can enrol their children at the same time.

- Maximum number of bookings (number): What is the maximum number of people that can enrol per form?
- Collect basic data from: (radio_group)
    · All bookings — Each booking provides its own name, email, and phone independently.
    · Only the first booking — Only the first booking (the person submitting the form) provides name, email, and phone. The remaining bookings inherit these basic details.
- Collect additional data (additional fields) from: (radio_group): This setting controls which bookings must submit the mandatory additional fields. It does not control whether the buyer or the attendee fills the field — the booking form handles that automatically.
    · All bookings — Every booking must fill in the mandatory additional fields. Use this when each booking represents a distinct attendee whose details you need.
    · All bookings except the first — The first booking is exempt from the additional fields. Use this when the form submitter is also an attendee but the additional fields describe a different person — typically a parent who books for both themselves and their child, where the child's details (date of birth, school, etc.) are collected on the second booking but the parent's are not.
- If the class reaches full capacity, do not show it in the booking form (toggle)
- Hide from booking form (number of hours) before the programme begins: (number): The programme will not be available for booking the indicated number of hours before the programme begins. The programme will not appear on the booking form.
- Allow register now, start later (toggle): A customer can register now but begin on a later date. You set only how far ahead they may start; individual start dates are not managed here.
- Priority registration (toggle): Let eligible returning customers register before the class opens to everyone. You set the priority-open moment and, optionally, when it opens to the public. Who is eligible is handled automatically.

You can change the list of people with access to your account at any time.
- Attendance management settings for instructors: (radio_group)
    · Full report (attended, did not attend, cancelled, choose a make-up session)
    · Limited message (attended, did not attend)
- Availability management settings for instructors: (radio_group)
    · Full report (Users manage their own availability and absences)
    · Restricted administration (Any change to availability and absences must be approved by the owner)
    · Absences only (Instructor can only request absences)
- Session cancellation policy (radio_group)
    · None
    · Make-up session required - instructor cannot cancel a session without setting a make-up session
    · Full - instructor can freely cancel any session he's entitled to
- Allow instructors to create session substitutions (toggle): This setting will allow instructors to manage substitutions by themselves. Each substitution needs to be confirmed by the substituting instructor and upon each new substitution request, instructor will need to select an administator which will get e-mail notification about this change.
- Allow all instructor roles to send email or SMS messages to clients from the session detail. (toggle): This will enable instructors to send quick messages directly from the session detail. The message will be sent to all of session's participants.
- Allow external instructors to see client's personal data in session detail (toggle): By default all personal data about clients are hidden for external instructors. If enabled, external instructors will be able to see personal data for example in case of emergency when they need to reach parents quickly. Each display of these data is logged in the system.
- Allow instructors to see financial information (toggle): When turned off, all instructor roles (main, regular and external instructors) lose access to client financial information: the Payments section, payment amounts on bookings, invoices, credits and financial reports. Owners, assistants and receptionists are unaffected.
- Allow main instructors to access the Payments section (toggle): Grant or deny access to the Payments section of the application. This includes: Payments overview, Received payments, Scheduled payments and Invoices
